race.comment: RAINSUN (5) resumes. He showed good ability in four runs last time in, putting up two strong performances including a win over Nearco Frod who went on to win his next four. He was very well backed in a handy race at Flemington before the break and looks a strong chance fresh. FLYING MIKKI (2) is racing well without winning. Got a long way back in the Country Final at Flemington but hit the line nicely and should be hard to hold out again. TORN (6) has won two on the bounce, dominant at Ballarat last start on heavy ground. Drier now is the question but he's flying. SEETHRU (3) resumed with a good win at Warrnambool and can go on with it from PRINCE MAGNETITE (4) who will be hitting the line.
